expected:
/**
 * Checks if the given value is a string.
 *
 * @param mixed $value
 *   The value to check.
 *
 * @return bool
 *   TRUE if the given value is a string.
 *
 * @phpstan-assert-if-true string $value
 */
function isString(mixed $value): bool
{
    return is_string($value);
}

/**
 * Checks if the given value is an int.
 *
 * @param mixed $value
 *   The value to check.
 *
 * @return bool
 *   TRUE if the given value is an int.
 *
 * @phpstan-assert-if-true int $value
 */
function isInt(mixed $value): bool
{
    return is_int($value);
}

/**
 * Checks if the given value is a PostSummary.
 *
 * @param mixed $value
 *   The value to check.
 *
 * @return bool
 *   TRUE if the given value is a PostSummary.
 *
 * @phpstan-assert-if-true PostSummary $value
 */
function isPostSummary(mixed $value): bool
{
    return (is_array($value) && array_key_exists('id', $value) && array_key_exists('title', $value) && is_int($value['id']) && is_string($value['title']));
}
